name: Storyteller Nexus
description: Data-driven, structured randomness for coherent yet varied stories. Templates combine acts, beats, and {repo} rolls so agents can run consistent, replayable stories in chat or anywhere else—independent of Worlds.

settings.name: libraryFolder
settings.label: Library folder
settings.description: Optional. Holds templates/, repos/ and pois/ as JSON you edit by hand (not encrypted); they're used alongside the ones in Data. Story runs found in its stories/ folder are copied into the vault once.

kinds.label: Story template
kinds.description: data-driven story blueprint: acts, beats, thresholds, and {repo} random rolls for varied runs

kinds.label: Story POI
kinds.description: reusable location or encounter seed that Storyteller templates can roll and draw into a run

kinds.label: Branching story
kinds.description: finished interactive story in passages, where the reader's choices lead to other passages
